name: adu-dashboard
description: ADU Construction Progress Dashboard - workspace root

scripts.type-check: bun run --filter @adu-dashboard/ui type-check && bun run --filter @adu-dashboard/api type-check
scripts.test: cd tests && bun install && bun run test
scripts.test:e2e: cd tests && bun install && bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:all: cd tests && bun install && bun run test:all
scripts.test:watch: cd tests && bun install && bun run test -- --watch
